  46→def stripped(css):
  47→    return re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', css, flags=re.S).lower()

  50→def rules(css, context=()):
  51→    """Retain declarations and media context; freeze other at-blocks opaquely."""
  52→    pos = 0
  53→    while pos < len(css):
  54→        start = css.find('{', pos)
  55→        if start < 0:
  56→            break
  57→        head = ' '.join(css[pos:start].split())
  58→        depth, end = 1, start + 1
  59→        while end < len(css) and depth:
  60→            depth += (css[end] == '{') - (css[end] == '}')
  61→            end += 1
  62→        assert depth == 0, 'unbalanced CSS block'
  63→        body = css[start + 1:end - 1]
  64→        if head.startswith('@media'):
  65→            yield from rules(body, context + (head,))
  66→        elif not head.startswith('@'):
  67→            # Existing :has argument has no comma. No selector-list functional pseudos.
  68→            selectors = tuple(' '.join(s.strip().split()) for s in head.split(','))
  69→            decls = tuple((p.strip(), ' '.join(v.split()))
  70→                          for p, v in re.findall(r'([\w-]+)\s*:\s*([^;]+);?', body))
  71→            yield context, selectors, decls
  72→        else:
  73→            yield context, (head,), (('__opaque__', ' '.join(body.split())),)
  74→        pos = end

  77→def active(context, width):
  78→    for query in context:
  79→        matches = re.findall(r'(max|min)-width:\s*([\d.]+)px', query)
  80→        assert matches, 'unsupported media query in source contract: ' + query
  81→        if any((kind == 'max' and width > float(n)) or
  82→               (kind == 'min' and width < float(n)) for kind, n in matches):
  83→            return False
  84→    return True

  87→def specificity(selector):
  88→    # :has adopts its argument's specificity, it does not add a pseudo-class.
  89→    selector = selector.replace(':has(', '(')
  90→    ids = len(re.findall(r'#[\w-]+', selector))
  91→    classes = len(re.findall(r'\.[\w-]+|\[[^]]+\]|:(?!:)[\w-]+', selector))
  92→    plain = re.sub(r'#[\w-]+|\.[\w-]+|\[[^]]+\]|:[\w-]+', '', selector)
  93→    tags = len(re.findall(r'(?:^|[\s>+~(])([a-z][\w-]*)', plain))
  94→    return ids, classes, tags

  97→def expanded(prop, value):
  98→    important = bool(re.search(r'\s*!important\s*$', value))
  99→    value = re.sub(r'\s*!important\s*$', '', value)
 100→    out = {prop: value}
 101→    if prop in ('margin', 'padding'):
 102→        bits = value.split()
 103→        assert 1 <= len(bits) <= 4, 'unsupported box shorthand: ' + value
 104→        top = bits[0]
 105→        right = bits[1] if len(bits) > 1 else top
 106→        bottom = bits[2] if len(bits) > 2 else top
 107→        left = bits[3] if len(bits) > 3 else right
 108→        out.update({prop + '-' + side: val for side, val in
 109→                    zip(('top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'), (top, right, bottom, left))})
 110→    if prop == 'gap':
 111→        out['row-gap'] = value.split()[0]
 112→        out['column-gap'] = value.split()[-1]
 113→    if prop == 'background':
 114→        out['background-color'] = value
 115→    if prop == 'border':
 116→        bits = value.split()
 117→        out['border-width'] = bits[0]
 118→        out['border-style'] = bits[1] if len(bits) > 1 else 'none'
 119→        out['border-color'] = ' '.join(bits[2:]) if len(bits) > 2 else 'currentcolor'
 120→    return out, important

 123→def cascade(css, selectors, width=1200):
 124→    """Explicit markup profile, including base ancestors/types and state selectors."""
 125→    winners = {}
 126→    for order, (context, group, decls) in enumerate(rules(css)):
 127→        if not active(context, width):
 128→            continue
 129→        for selector in group:
 130→            if selector not in selectors:
 131→                continue
 132→            for index, (prop, value) in enumerate(decls):
 133→                values, important = expanded(prop, value)
 134→                rank = (important, specificity(selector), order, index)
 135→                for key, val in values.items():
 136→                    if key not in winners or rank >= winners[key][0]:
 137→                        winners[key] = rank, val
 138→    return {p: v for p, (_, v) in winners.items()}

   3→Why this exists (glm-5.3 review of sessions twelve and thirteen, 2026-09-29): the
   4→selector-list pins in tests/test_console_rebrand.py only see the rules they name. A new
   5→rule appended at the end of a file, a status rule nobody listed, or a swap between two
   6→accent tokens all changed real rendered colours while the suite stayed green (15 of 22
   7→mutations survived). The ledger closes that class: ANY change to a colour declaration,
   8→anywhere, turns tests/test_session_sixteen.py red until the ledger is re-baselined on
   9→purpose.
  10→
  11→Duplicates are kept and order is kept, because the cascade depends on both.
  12→
  13→Usage:
  14→    python3 tools/colour_ledger.py            # print the ledger as JSON
  15→    python3 tools/colour_ledger.py --write    # re-baseline tests/fixtures/colour_ledger.json
  16→
  17→Re-baseline only after a colour change the operator has approved.
  18→"""
  19→from __future__ import annotations
  20→
  21→import json
  22→import re
  23→import sys
  24→from pathlib import Path
  25→from typing import Dict, List
  26→
  27→REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
  28→SHEETS = ["ui/styles.css", "ui/party/party.css"]
  29→FIXTURE = REPO / "tests" / "fixtures" / "colour_ledger.json"
  30→
  31→_COLOUR_PROP = re.compile(
  32→    r"^(--[\w-]+|color|background(-color|-image)?|border(-(top|right|bottom|left))?(-color)?"
  33→    r"|outline(-color)?|box-shadow|text-decoration(-color)?|fill|stroke|caret-color|accent-color)$"
  34→)
  35→_COLOUR_VALUE = re.compile(r"var\(|#|rgb|hsl|transparent|currentcolor|\b(white|black)\b")
  36→
  37→
  38→def ledger_for(css: str) -> List[List[str]]:
  39→    """[selector list, property, value] for every colour declaration, source order."""
  40→    css = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", css, flags=re.S).lower()
  41→    rows: List[List[str]] = []
  42→    for match in re.finditer(r"([^{}]+)\{([^{}]*)\}", css):
  43→        selector = ", ".join(" ".join(s.split()) for s in match.group(1).split(","))
  44→        for prop, value in re.findall(r"([\w-]+)\s*:\s*([^;]+);?", match.group(2)):
  45→            prop = prop.strip()
  46→            value = " ".join(value.split())
  47→            if _COLOUR_PROP.match(prop) and (prop.startswith("--") or _COLOUR_VALUE.search(value)):
  48→                rows.append([selector, prop, value])
  49→    return rows
  50→
  51→
  52→def build(repo: Path = REPO) -> Dict[str, List[List[str]]]:
  53→    return {sheet: ledger_for((repo / sheet).read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for sheet in SHEETS}
  54→
  55→
  56→if __name__ == "__main__":
  57→    data = build()
  58→    text = json.dumps(data, indent=1) + "\n"
  59→    if "--write" in sys.argv[1:]:
  60→        FIXTURE.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
  61→        print("wrote %s (%s)" % (FIXTURE, ", ".join("%s: %d" % (k, len(v)) for k, v in data.items())))
  62→    else:
  63→        sys.stdout.write(text)

  38→def _handler_body(js: str, element_id: str, event: str = "click") -> str:
